digest.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
digest.tldr: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

digest.title: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?
Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
